coastal-escape: Pale driftwood-grey wood-grain boards. Any railing is white with slim dark balusters, and any stairs end on a small concrete landing. Furniture in white frames with blue-and-white cushions. Beach grasses and white hydrangeas in mulched beds along the foot of the deck.
modern-minimalist: Charcoal-grey wood-grain boards. Any railing is matte black with vertical balusters, and any stairs end on a small concrete landing. Furniture in black and grey; any fire pit in smooth concrete. Tall dark planters with ornamental grasses and mulched planting beds along the foot of the deck.
english-country-cottage: Warm greige wood-grain boards. Any railing is cream with turned balusters, and any stairs end on a small stone landing. Cushions in soft cottage colours and terracotta pots of lavender. A cottage garden border with foxgloves and boxwood along the foot of the deck.
scandinavian-hygge: Pale blond wood-grain boards. Any railing has light wood posts and rails with slim light grey metal balusters, and any stairs end on a small concrete landing. Furniture in light wood with cream sheepskin throws, and a couple of lanterns. Soft ornamental grasses along the foot of the deck.
natural-rustic: Deep brown wood-grain boards. Any railing has dark brown timber posts and rails with black metal balusters, and any stairs end on a small concrete landing. Furniture in dark wood with plaid cushions. Ferns and boulders in mulched beds along the foot of the deck.
